arStrings.szText: After casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill, your {c_important}Servants{/c}, {c_important}Minions{/c} and {c_important}Companions{/c} are empowered with dark magics, growing larger in size and dealing {c_random}[SF_3*100|x%|]{/c} bonus {c_important}Summoning{/c} damage{if:SF_2} and gaining {c_number}100%{/c} Critical Strike Chance{/if}. Lasts {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} seconds.
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
Your {c_important}Summons{/c} deal guaranteed Critical Strikes while enlarged.
